llm_review.summary: High-quality corpus-grounded knowledge-only skill with excellent evidence discipline. Quote integrity: 44 verifications performed and all passed — 25 quotes spot-checked verbatim against analysis/video_notes/<id>.md across 16 different videos (momentum two-phase, first-breakout skepticism, S&D base rule, both confluence counts, turtle-soup Linda Raschke origin, RSI 80/20, pivot settings, 80/20 subjectivity rule, 6-8 candle order expiry, all three EMA-parameter eras, RR 1:3 preference, fifth-wave stop rule, ICI naming, examples), 12 harmonic XABCD ratio checks confirmed every Bat/Butterfly/Gartley number (50/61.8/78.6/88.6/127.2/38.2, X-point stop, A-D 61.8 target, 1:1 floor) comes from 6_5DVT6uS9E's note rather than generic harmonic-trading textbooks (and the skill correctly covers only the three patterns the speaker taught, omitting Crab/Shark/Cypher), and 7 '(transcript)'-labeled quotes (candle-thirds grading, clock method, momentum definition) verified verbatim in data/transcripts/pK6S7CEqMAk.txt. Contradiction tiers per profile 7.3 are preserved, not smoothed: confluence 2-3 vs 3-5 (same-video, explicitly flagged), RR floor 1:1/1:2/1:3 layered by strategy context, MA evolution 100-day to EMA50 to 21/50/200 presented as dated evolution with EMA50 default, and breakout vs breakout-pullback kept as parallel options with the speaker's stated preference as default. DRY is clean: PD Array vocabulary is referenced to lun-ict-pd-arrays everywhere (never redefined), liquidity mechanics, kill-zone session details, MTF workflow, OTE steps, and exit management are consistently deferred with inline annotations even inside evidence quotes. Honest-limitation quality is high (single-source harmonic warning, unverified win-rate claims, 13-vs-14 strategy count discrepancy disclosed, fragmented-transcript warning). The main deduction is the hardcoded absolute user path echoing the auto-axis high finding, plus two minor nits.

findings.message: The path note hardcodes the absolute user path /Users/lui/workspace/LunTrading (single occurrence, verified by grep). This embeds the username in the skill file (mild PII), breaks if the project moves, and triggers the auto-axis high finding. The intent of the note (clarify project-root-relative paths) is good but the literal home-directory path is unnecessary to achieve it.
findings.improvement: Replace the literal path with a generic anchor, e.g. 路徑係相對於 LunTrading 項目根目錄（即本 skill 所在 .claude/ 目錄嘅上一層）, so the note stays self-locating without any absolute user path. Apply the same wording to the sibling skill lun-ict-pd-arrays SKILL.md line 149 which uses the identical pattern.

findings.message: The harmonic table compresses the Bat B-point into '50%，「可以超過50%，但是不可以碰到61.8%」', dropping the speaker's other same-video statement 「我們要等待50%的回調，那一定要是50%，不可以超過」. evidence.md line 140 correctly preserves both contradictory phrasings, but a reader using only the SKILL.md table sees a single reconciled rule.
findings.improvement: Add a footnote marker in the table cell pointing to evidence.md section 11's dual phrasing (strict-50% vs may-exceed-but-below-61.8), consistent with the skill's own 矛盾口徑照錄 policy in limitation 3.

findings.message: Limitation 2 lists example unverified R-multiples (1對4.8、一對七、1:22.45) but omits the Triple Test 「一对二十」 claim quoted in evidence.md line 57, which is the largest single self-reported multiple in this skill's corpus and the most likely to be over-trusted.
findings.improvement: Add 一对二十（VjSB-VRyxWI，Triple Test） to the example list in limitation 2.
